summary: Logistic Properties of the Americas, a NYSE American-listed Latin American industrial REIT and foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 14, 2026, announcing management participation in the Water Tower Research Virtual Insights Conference on September 22-23, 2026. CEO Esteban Saldarriaga and CFO Paul Smith will host a fireside chat webcast and one-on-one investor meetings; no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This is a routine investor-relations event notice, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle applies; portfolio stands at 34 logistics facilities across Costa Rica, Colombia, Peru and Mexico.
